## Example files

Build your own file and use examples to check individual operations. Project 4 field and contouring groups may be reused with credit; students still build their own matrix and develop their own envelope. The point-cloud file is a supplementary example, not a required assignment. Select the lesson object and press Home over the node editor to see the whole graph. Read the Frames in order. Change the inputs on the nodes or, where there are controls, in the GeometryNodes modifier.

Prepared in **Blender 5.2.1 LTS**. Older Blender versions may not have the volume nodes used in later classes.

**[Descriptive Geometry]({{ site.baseurl }}/files/blender/02-geometry-fundamentals/GEOMETRY101-class-ready.blend)** — download .blend

1. Point
2. Line
3. Edge
4. Face
5. Solid
6. Boolean

Follow the six main teaching scenes; the original reference scenes are still in the file. The pyramid keeps Width, Depth and Height exposed, and the file ends with the cube minus the pyramid. This lesson works in model units; nothing is exported for fabrication.

**Practice:** Show a point, a line, an edge, a face, a solid pyramid and a cube with the pyramid cut out. Keep Width, Depth and Height exposed, and include a mesh with several faces.
